services.desc: Whether this is the beginning of a career in aviation for you, or if a private rating is all you desire, this will be the beginning of a new and exciting future. This course will take six-eight weeks for a full-time student to complete and may be tailored to fit the individual needs of anyone. If your schedule or budget requires or is limited to one or two lessons per week, we can accommodate this but the duration will be longer. The minimum number of flight hours required to obtain your private certificate is 40 hours by FAA regulation. On average, it takes most students 50-60 hours to complete the certificate.
